scripts.api:dev: cd apps/intelligence-api && PY=$([ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) && $PY -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:test: cd apps/intelligence-api && PY=$([ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) && $PY -m pytest
scripts.api:evaluate: cd apps/intelligence-api && PY=$([ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) && $PY -m app.cli.evaluate
scripts.discovery:dry-run: cd apps/intelligence-api && PY=$([ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3) && $PY -m app.cli.discovery --theme grid-infrastructure --dry-run
